decision_scope: one preregistered service diagnostic only; no scientific evidence, hypothesis, experiment plan, scoring seed, candidate, benchmark, schema or scoring

allowed_data.dronepropa: candidate-visible train and validation FlightExamples only; test, privileged support, paths and private factors forbidden
allowed_data.wt: fit files 0-5 and development files 6-7 only; test files 8-9 forbidden

required_pair_contract.natural_views: at least two observations of one persistent latent entity must arise without an evaluator-supplied positive-pair relation
required_pair_contract.identity_absence: correspondence may not be reconstructed from slot, container membership, row position, temporal adjacency, path, family, condition, channel name or another semantic label
required_pair_contract.representation: useful identity variation must be non-axis-aligned or nonlinear; a stable raw coordinate subset is insufficient
required_pair_contract.task_distinction: a supervised feature-target transition or forecasting pair is not an identity-view pair
required_pair_contract.heldout_test: the relation must be learnable on allowed fit data and testable on disjoint development data

controls.pair_break: deterministically cyclically shift the second view by one record within each source group; any learned pair signal must collapse toward chance
controls.exact_clustering: fit-only whitened agglomerative or nearest-centroid linkage over anonymous views
controls.ann: fixed deterministic sign-projection hash followed by exact within-bucket scan
controls.oracle: offline same-record correspondence used only to score development retrieval and never supplied to an implementable learner

diagnostic_order: inventory candidate-visible objects and all sources of correspondence
reject prediction/transition pairs and supplied identity before numerical interpretation
only if a qualifying view pair exists, run the frozen controls and cyclic pair break
pass_rule: both DronePropA and WT must expose a qualifying natural pair contract, at least one must exhibit non-axis or nonlinear identity variation, exact classical controls must not already solve development retrieval, and cyclic pair breaking must remove the learned advantage; otherwise record no_nonaxis_identity_acquisition_contract

outcomes.pass: a later wake may propose one low-confidence HYP-0001 experiment using an existing frozen cohort
outcomes.fail: keep HYP-0001 dormant; create no hypothesis, candidate, experiment plan, benchmark or schema and do not tune latent_entity_binding_retrieval_v1
